restatement: Add a reusable golden-file harness, runGoldenCases(casesDir, render, options), in tests/golden/harness.ts. It finds every case folder under tests/golden/cases/<name>/ in sorted order. Each folder holds template.md, data.json, an optional options.json, and either expected.md or expected-error.txt. The harness renders each case through the render function it is given and compares the result byte for byte. A failure names the case and shows the first differing line. An error case passes when the thrown message contains the trimmed expected text. Under UPDATE_GOLDEN=1, or options.update, it rewrites the expected files instead of failing. The work also ships at least eight plain-file cases (IF/ELSEIF, CASE, nested FOR, LIST, TABLE, filters, ?? defaults, one error case) that pass against the real resolver. It must not edit existing test bodies or add a runtime dependency. This serves the cycle goal of golden-file tests that stay green in CI on a clean clone.
verification_plan: Confirm tests/golden/harness.ts exports runGoldenCases(casesDir, render, options) and that render is a parameter, not a hard-coded resolver.

c1: case folders are discovered (directories only, sorted), template, data and options are parsed and passed to render, and the comparison is strict string equality with no trimming or newline normalization of either side.
c2: a mismatch returns passed=false with a message that names the case, gives the 1-based first differing line, and shows both the actual and expected lines and no later differing line.
c3: an expected-error.txt case passes only when render throws a message containing the trimmed file text, and fails (naming the case) when render does not throw or throws something else.

c4: options.update and UPDATE_GOLDEN=1 (when options.update is undefined) rewrite expected.md or expected-error.txt to match the actual outcome, create missing files, and leave nothing stale behind. update:false never writes.

c5: at least eight case folders with template.md, data.json and exactly one expected file, whose names cover if, case, for, list, table, filter, default and error, and all of them pass against the real resolveTemplate.
Cross-platform: fixtures compare byte for byte on the windows CI runner (line-ending pinning).
m1: the diff modifies or deletes no existing test file.
m2: package.json and its dependencies are untouched, and the harness uses only node built-ins.
Rubric: the case files are plain, readable inputs and outputs with nothing generated by code.
Goal-critical: each frozen test in tests/golden-harness.test.ts fails before the change (the harness module is missing) and passes after, and the pre-existing suite is unaffected.

findings.title: harness.ts uses `any` in GoldenRender without the eslint disable that the frozen test carries

serves.scenario: If CI lints tests/ under @typescript-eslint/no-explicit-any, harness.ts would raise lint errors. The frozen test file disables that rule explicitly; the new harness does not. Whether CI lints tests/ is not shown in the packet, so this is a note for the lead, not a fix request.

findings.rubric: cycle-goal: a clean clone installs, builds and tests green in CI
findings.reproduction: Run the project's eslint over tests/golden/harness.ts with @typescript-eslint/no-explicit-any enabled. Expect two errors at the data and options parameters of GoldenRender.
